https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/tin-can/2dcec8c.description: ABOUT TIN CAN Tin Can is building a safer, simpler way for kids to connect — without smartphones. Working closely with our Creative, Brand, and Growth Marketing teams is a core (and extremely fun) part of this role. You say yes more than no, but still, you know when to say no. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own our referral program, making it a core component of our growth engine - Build a kid-to-kid sharing program so Tin Can gets hyped everywhere they go, and the best way to reach them is in the real (non-digital) world - Give Growth Marketing the tools and systems to move fast, from landing pages to attribution - Support bringing brand campaigns and experiences to life, on and off the screen, from concept through execution - Be a partner to Brand, shaping ambitious ideas with them, not just executing on their behalf - Align Creative, Growth Marketing, and Engineering on what's next, stitching dreams into reality - Get scrappy when the job calls for it — whatever it takes to make something real WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 5+ years of product management experience, ideally with experience in growth or brand; bonus points for work with a brand that gets it - You get ish done, rallying diverse groups, finding resources, keeping everyone on track - Crystal clear communication, from prank call campaigns to attribution pipelines - Experience collaborating closely with designers, creatives, and supply chain teams - Excellent visual taste; you know something's great the moment you see it (we call it razzle-dazzle) (jk, nobody actually calls it that) - Technical and data fluency — you get numbers, think in systems, understand scaling - Fluency using AI as a multiplier in your work; this is how we work, not a nice-to-have - Ownership mindset — you're a PM, but also a "call everywhere in Seattle to estimate sticker cost"-er when it counts - Low ego, high enthusiasm — you cheer as loud for someone else's idea as your own WHY JOIN TIN CAN - We're building tech that protects childhood: We're on a quest to give kids a more analog childhood — one with real conversations, real connection, and way less screen time. Evaluate and make recommendations regarding technical advances that improve productivity and quality, reduce flow times, and enhance operational surety. Develop guidelines and standards for analytics and machine learning models, their deployment, and associated processes. Provide technical guidance or business process expertise, technical leadership, coaching and mentoring to team members.
